title: C# syntax basics: names, operators, control flow, and directives
intro: This module teaches the building blocks of C# syntax: how to name variables, write expressions, make decisions, repeat work, and tell the compiler what to include. Every topic uses plain English, code you can run, and comparisons with JavaScript so nothing feels mysterious.

overviewDiagram.title: How C# source becomes running logic

flowchart LR
  A[Names and literals] --> B[Operators and expressions]
  B --> C{Decision needed?}
  C -->|Yes| D[if / switch]
  C -->|Repeat| E[Loops]
  E --> F[Jump statements]
  B --> G[checked / nameof / sizeof]
  A --> H[Compiler directives]

conceptCards.title: Identifiers, keywords, and literals
conceptCards.summary: Names you choose, words the language reserves, and typed values you write directly. C# has no Automatic Semicolon Insertion (ASI).
conceptCards.example: int count = 199; decimal price = 1.5m; string json = """{"ok":true}""";

conceptCards.title: Operators and null handling
conceptCards.summary: Arithmetic, comparison, logical, and null-coalescing (??) / null-conditional (?.) operators. C# 14 adds ?. on the left of assignment.

conceptCards.title: if and switch decisions
conceptCards.summary: if requires a bool condition — no truthy numbers. Classic switch compares constants and needs break or goto case.

conceptCards.title: for, while, and foreach loops
conceptCards.summary: foreach walks a sequence; for uses an index; while and do-while test conditions. Do not modify a list during foreach.

conceptCards.title: break, continue, return, goto
conceptCards.summary: Jump statements transfer control. goto case is the only legal switch fall-through. return sets the process exit code.

conceptCards.title: checked, nameof, sizeof
conceptCards.summary: checked throws on integer overflow. nameof gives rename-safe symbol strings. sizeof reports unmanaged value type bytes.

conceptCards.title: Compiler directives
conceptCards.summary: #if strips code at compile time. #nullable toggles null-safety warnings. #region is editor folding only.
